tasks_menu_hint: A task file (GeoJSON) with map tasks, kept private on this device and in your OSM account
tasks_empty: No task list loaded. Choose “Load task list…” in the account menu, or add tasks=<address of the file> to the link.
tasks_error_title: {file} is not a valid task file
tasks_fetch_failed: The file could not be loaded: {reason}
tasks_read_only: This feature is read-only because of a filter: the option cannot be applied.
tasks_missing: The feature is not loaded on the map yet.
tasks_no_feature: This task names no feature: set these tags by hand.
tasks_sync_local: Only in this browser: log in to keep it on your OSM account
tasks_sync_saved_mock: Saved in the mock (lost on restart)
tasks_sync_forbidden: The login lacks permission to store preferences: log out and in again
tasks_sync_mismatch: Your account holds this list for another version of the file: this browser’s state is kept and not synced
tasks_sync_conflict: This list was changed on another device
tasks_conflict_title: This list was changed on another device
tasks_conflict_text: The statuses in your OSM account and in this browser both changed since they last matched. Which ones do you want to keep?
tasks_cleanup_title: Old task lists in your OSM account
tasks_cleanup_text: These lists were not changed for 30 days and use space in your OSM preferences. Nothing is deleted unless you choose Delete.
tasks_cleanup_failed: This did not work. Try again later.
tasks_select_feature: Select the feature on the map to apply an option.
tasks_creates_point: Adds a new point at the task's place.
tasks_creates_line: Adds a new line along the task's geometry.
tasks_creates_area: Adds a new area with the task's outline.
tasks_not_loaded: Not loaded on the map yet.
tasks_reopen_to_apply: The task is done. Reopen it to apply this option again.
tasks_delete_part_of_relation: This feature can't be deleted because it is part of a larger relation. Remove it from the relation first.
tasks_delete_incomplete: This feature can't be deleted because it hasn't been fully downloaded.
tasks_delete_wikidata: This feature can't be deleted because it has a Wikidata tag.
